get_country_code: convert a country name or code to its ISO alpha-2 code if supported by the Facebook Ads Library API
is_valid_fields: check if a given field name is a valid query field for the Facebook Ads Library API
supported_countries: list all ISO alpha-2 country codes supported by the Facebook Ads Library API
valid_query_fields: list all valid query field names supported by the Facebook Ads Library API
review_get_country_code: review the get_country_code function to understand how it converts country names to alpha-2 codes
